dedupe_keys.name: 511 sf bay open data portal traffic and transit apis for the san francisco bay area

description: 511 SF Bay's Open Data Portal is the central place for free access to 511 traffic and transit data for the nine-county San Francisco Bay Area through APIs, using a token requested by form. The traffic page lists an events endpoint with all active and planned incidents and events on major highways and an endpoint with tolls for all bridges and express lanes, with a technical specification to download; the default rate limit is 60 requests per 3,600 seconds per token, and higher limits can be requested. A separate section offers real-time transit data APIs. Coverage: the nine Bay Area counties. Format and access: REST APIs with a free token. Licence and cost: free under 511 terms. Caveats: the rate limit constrains bulk harvesting, and historical archives are not described on the pages read. It supports network flow and emergency response studies using incident and toll data. It relates to Caltrans PeMS and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
